Terms of Service

Last updated: October 13, 2026

  1. Home
  2. Terms of Service

These terms apply to your use of dfwexpertroofers.com and the phone line shown on it, both run by DFW Expert Roofers, a d/b/a of Dominion Digital Group ("the line", "we", "us"). By using the site or calling the line, you agree to them.

What the line is

DFW Expert Roofers is a free referral phone line and website. It is not a roofing contractor. An automated assistant answers calls, asks about your roof and your location, and transfers you to, or passes your details to, an independent roofing company in Dallas-Fort Worth. We do not inspect, quote, repair, replace, tarp or install anything, we do not handle insurance claims, and we do not employ or supervise the roofing companies.

The roofing company is independent

Any inspection, estimate, contract, work, warranty and payment is solely between you and the roofing company you choose. We make no promise about any company's work, pricing, schedule, licensing, insurance or conduct, and we are not a party to your agreement with it. Texas does not issue a state roofing license, so before you hire, check the company yourself: ask for proof of insurance, a written contract, and any permit or city registration your city requires. Our guide to checking a roofer lists what to ask for.

Referral fees

Calling and being connected costs you nothing. The line can collect a referral fee from the roofer. That fee does not change what you pay a company unless the company itself tells you otherwise.

Information on the site

The guides and pages on this site are general information about roofing, storms, permits and insurance in North Texas. They are not legal, insurance, engineering or financial advice. Rules, codes and policies change and differ by city and insurer; confirm anything important with the city, your insurer or a qualified professional. We cite our sources and try to keep facts current, but we do not promise the site is complete or free of errors.

Safety

This site never asks you to climb onto a roof or do roof work yourself. Stay off damaged roofs, keep away from downed power lines and call 911 in an emergency.

Acceptable use

Please do not misuse the forms or the phone line, submit false information, or try to disrupt the site. We may block traffic or calls that abuse the service.

Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, the line and Dominion Digital Group are not liable for any loss arising from your use of the site, the phone line, or any roofing company you are connected with, including property damage, workmanship problems, delays or insurance outcomes. The site and line are provided as they are, without warranties of any kind.

Links to other sites

The site links to government agencies, news reports and other sources. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for their content.

Governing law and changes

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Texas. We may update them from time to time; the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions? Call (469) 649-7066 or use the contact form.
